nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza A & RSV are in “High” category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in “Medium” category. The other respiratory viruses (Influenza B, HMPV, & EV-D68) remain in “Low” wastewater category nationwide & not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/YxSgatQ0cc

nodes.author: JN1171
WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “Medium” category with medium concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/vkeRY12ylx

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.3 variant in light blue (29.4%) and XEC variant in green (20.4%) make up approximately 50% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/idFWD6gI2E

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “Low” category nationally, but in the high category in the West and Northeast. https://t.co/fnmxSCNWaS

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 detected in 21 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 4 in the South, and 4 in the Northeast. As of 2/26/25, 17 of these states have also reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections have been in CA, MA, & NJ. https://t.co/e8MIRNbnPO

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations with a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/W4Fh0TmBPR

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HPMV: HMPV is in the “Low” category nationally, but is in onset and in the “High” category in most regions (West, Midwest, and Northeast). https://t.co/R4sV6gN9Iw

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ EV-D68: EV-D68 is in the “Low” category nationally and in all regions. https://t.co/WTyIQ3g1sc

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 9/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions remain in the “High” category. https://t.co/X4u5vRvPZY
